source_snapshot.procedure: Map memory with mc.dimminfo(), then inject one rank-0 CE using the explicit socket/channel/dimm/sub_channel tuple.
source_snapshot.criteria: System remains normal; BMC and applicable UEFI identify the correct slot; front-panel and DIMM lightpath remain off.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; delegates injection but incorrectly assumes Linux dmesg on Windows and cannot prove slot or physical off-state.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION; needs a complete tuple-to-slot map, bounded per-slot sequence and authoritative evidence.

old_problem: Package/topology and applicability were unbound, and the earlier review treated those execution inputs plus DeepSeek's Windows/dmesg mismatch as an Engineering Decision rather than a parameterized run gate.
disposition_reason: The source gives the exact CE operation, rank=0 scope and deterministic normal/no-light/slot-attribution outcome. ED-03 permits the populated tuple map, package build, expected Windows/BMC/UEFI fields and hardware applicability as runtime configuration; ED-16 requires tool approval, isolation and recovery before execution but does not keep a fully specified review Pending. Rank=0 is preserved rather than expanded to unrequested all-rank coverage.
decision_basis: Directly read XLSX Reliability rows 13 and 14 and same-row DeepSeek fields.
Read historical record 2419 and preserved exact identity/hashes.
Treat Memory slot 1~N as every in-scope populated slot, with the source's literal rank=0 injection once per approved tuple.
Require full mc.dimminfo-to-physical-label reconciliation; a generic CE record cannot prove correct-slot coverage.
Use authoritative Windows RAS evidence instead of DeepSeek's Linux dmesg assumption and retain physical off-state evidence.
No BIOS change, injection, log clear, retry or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Per-populated-slot rank-0 correctable ECC injection and attribution
test_case.purpose: Inject one CE into rank 0 of every approved populated memory slot, prove exact physical-slot attribution, continued normal operation and required no-light behavior.
required_package: SUT memory inventory and tuple-to-physical-slot map
Approved Intel ITP/CScripts build/hash and CE semantics
Windows/BMC/applicable UEFI corrected-error field map and indicator applicability
Abort, persistent-error check and BIOS restoration procedure
test_case.test_command: After FAE approval on an isolated SUT, preserve baseline evidence, capture complete `mc.dimminfo()`, reconcile each approved socket/channel/dimm/sub_channel tuple to a populated physical slot, and invoke `ei.injectMemError(socket, channel, dimm, sub_channel, rank=0, errType="ce")` exactly once per listed slot. After each target, capture complete Windows/BMC/applicable UEFI records, normal-operation evidence and front-panel/DIMM lightpath off-state before continuing.
test_case.expected_result: For every approved populated slot, exactly one rank-0 CE is attributed to the same physical label across authoritative records; the system remains in the signed normal-operation envelope; applicable UEFI records agree; and front-panel plus corresponding DIMM lightpath remain off.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires complete expected-versus-executed slot equality, verified tuple mapping, exact CE severity/slot identity, normal operation, required off-state images and restored baseline. Wrong/missing slot, duplicate/unbounded errors, generic CE text, unexpected lamp, crash, missing applicable evidence or restoration failure is not PASS.
safety_gate: Dedicated idle SUT, approved harness and qualified FAE/operator.
Preserve logs and cross-check each tuple with the physical slot before one injection.
Stop on wrong attribution, repeated/unbounded CE, unexpected lamp, crash, health anomaly or lost control.
No automatic retry or next-slot progression until current evidence and health are complete.
expected_evidence: Harness hash, full mc.dimminfo and signed tuple-to-slot matrix
Per-slot command transcript and authoritative Windows CE record
BMC and applicable UEFI slot attribution
Timestamped front-panel/DIMM lightpath off evidence and normal health
test_case.recovery: On wrong attribution, unexpected light, crash or persistent errors, preserve evidence and stop the sequence. Qualified engineering performs the approved recovery and BIOS restoration; do not clear records or retry automatically.

source_conflict.reason: The Windows oracle and applicability are bound explicitly; slot iteration is defined by the populated matrix while the source's rank=0 remains unchanged.

blocked.reason: The CE operation, coverage unit, oracle and recovery boundary are complete; project topology/package values are runtime prerequisites.

pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED AS PARAMETERIZED CONTROLLED RAS INJECTION; NO INJECTION OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.owner: Intel FAE/platform RAS owner binds the manifest and executes; end engineer owns verdict.
pending.unlock_condition: Bind and approve all topology, package, oracle and recovery inputs before the first injection.

project_authority: The memory population/topology recipe, Intel harness documentation and platform RAS event/indicator map control execution and acceptance.
